26460.hinweis:
There's a total of 3 chests (common, exquisite, precious) that you can collect here. This puzzle is essentially minesweeper, where the item revealed shows the number of bombs in the 4 adjacent tiles. 

1 vegetable = 1 in 4 adjacent tiles has a bomb
1 iron ore = 2 in 4 adjacent tiles has bomb

You only have a couple of tries each (real life) day. Keep trying till you get all three chests.
